stories.title: Mumbai property registrations dip during festive season
stories.summary: Mumbai property registrations fell 4 percent during the 2026 festive season compared to the previous year, according to Knight Frank India. Despite the decline, registrations remained higher than 2024 levels. The drop was attributed to a slowdown during the Navratri period.

stories.title: India's Housing Market Holds Steady in Q3 as Sales Rises 6.2% - Realty Plus Magazine
Prestige Estates launches North Bengaluru project
stories.summary: Prestige Estates has launched Prestige Avon, a residential project on Thanisandra Main Road in North Bengaluru. The development spans three acres and includes 260 apartments. The company estimates a gross development value of ₹550 crore for the project.

stories.title: M3M India plans luxury residences on Dwarka Expressway
stories.summary: M3M India is investing INR 1,650 crore to develop 120 Jacob and Co-branded luxury residences in Gurugram. The units will average 7,300 square feet, with prices starting at INR 26 crore. The project marks the developer's second collaboration with the watchmaker.

stories.title: India’s Real Estate Must Shift Towards City-Building
stories.summary: India’s real estate at a crossroads: From property development to building the cities of tomorrow India’s real estate industry stands at a defining crossroads. For decades, its growth has been measured through residential launches, commercial developments, rising property values, and expanding skylines. However, as the country prepares for its next

stories.title: Retrofitting Kolkata offices could unlock value
stories.summary: Retrofitting existing office buildings in Kolkata could unlock INR 4,800 crore in asset value, according to a Knight Frank India report. Nearly 25 percent of the city's office stock is eligible for modernisation, which could increase property valuations by 48 percent.

stories.title: County Group signs JDA for Noida land
stories.summary: County Group has entered a joint development agreement for a 24.71-acre land parcel in Sector 150, Noida, valued at 830 INR-crore. The developer plans to launch a luxury residential project in December 2026 and will also construct public sports facilities on the site.

stories.summary: Mehul R Thakkar is a Mumbai-based journalist who closely tracks the city’s ever-evolving real estate landscape. He believes that Mumbai presents a unique reality that, while Mumbaikars deeply aspire to own a home in the city of dreams, many spend little actual time living in it due to long commutes

stories.title: Sunteck Realty unveils Mira Road luxury tower
stories.summary: Sunteck Realty has launched the first tower of its Sunteck Belvedere Park project in Mira Road. The development features 2 and 3 BHK deck residences. The company describes the site as one of the most desirable residential addresses in the micro-market.

stories.title: Reclassify affordable housing loans: NHB | Financial Express Mumbai - newspaper - Magzter
National Housing Bank explores new loan classification
stories.summary: The National Housing Bank is consulting with stakeholders to create a separate affordable housing loan classification for Tier-II and Tier-III cities. The initiative aims to provide loans of up to Rs 15 lakh to better align with regional market needs.

stories.title: Smaller Cities Emerge as Key Markets for Affordable Housing Finance - Realty Plus Magazine
Supreme Court quashes Gaurs Group demand
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has quashed a ₹388-crore demand from the Uttar Pradesh government against Gaurs Group. The state had attempted to impose commercial pricing on land used for 2,900 houses in Ghaziabad. The court also ordered a fresh decision regarding local housing allotments.

stories.title: FMBN and NAFIL discuss housing for Air Force
stories.summary: The Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria and Nigerian Air Force Investments Limited are discussing a partnership to provide affordable housing for personnel. The framework aims to offer mortgage financing tailored to the income and employment structures of serving and retired Air Force members.

stories.title: FMBN expands recovered Abuja housing project
stories.summary: The Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria has recovered a 27.9-hectare site in Abuja from an abandoned 2012 project. The bank plans to increase the development from 962 to 1,358 units. The site was previously tied to a non-performing loan facility.

stories.title: India expects 43.7 million square feet of new retail space by 2030
stories.summary: JLL estimates India will add 43.7 million square feet of retail space across seven cities by 2030. Retailers leased 9.36 million square feet through September 2026, a 5.6 percent increase over the previous year. High streets accounted for 46.3 percent of that leasing activity, suggesting malls are not the only

stories.title: Auckland city fringe office vacancies fall as rail link opens
stories.summary: Office vacancy rates on Karangahape Road and Newton dropped by 3.3 and 2.2 percentage points respectively between March and September. Colliers research suggests the City Rail Link, which opened in September, is driving interest in these hubs as businesses prioritize public transport access for their office locations.

stories.title: Retrofitting Mumbai office buildings could unlock 1.78 lakh crore
stories.summary: Knight Frank India estimates that retrofitting existing office buildings in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region could yield an asset value uplift of approximately 1.78 lakh crore. With 39 percent of the region's office properties deemed suitable for such upgrades, the potential for commercial asset rejuvenation is considered significant.

stories.title: Dubai commercial market shifts as businesses expand
stories.summary: Dubai's commercial real estate market is evolving as international firms and new companies enter the emirate. The city's status as a global business hub is influencing demand for office and retail spaces, with businesses increasingly prioritizing location, workplace experience and technology over conventional office layouts.

stories.title: Bank of America signs 1,500 crore office lease in Hyderabad
stories.summary: Bank of America has leased over 1 million square feet of office space at Mindspace REIT’s Hyderabad campus for 12 years. The transaction, valued at 1,500 crore, is one of the largest individual office leasing deals in India this year by both area and rental value.

stories.title: Indian REITs distribute 3,234 crore as GCC demand climbs
stories.summary: India's six listed REITs distributed 3,234 crore to unitholders in the second quarter of FY27, a 38.7 percent increase from the previous year. The Indian REITs Association attributes this growth to strong demand for office space from Global Capability Centres and front-office enterprises.

stories.title: Khan Market retains spot as India's most expensive retail street
stories.summary: Delhi’s Khan Market remains India's most expensive retail destination, ranking 24th globally with annual rents of 238 dollars per square foot. According to Cushman and Wakefield, rents at the market rose 14 percent year-on-year, while Mumbai’s Linking Road recorded the fastest rental growth in the Asia-Pacific region.

stories.title: Nigeria's housing crisis persists despite government initiatives
stories.summary: Nigeria continues to announce new housing initiatives, mortgage rate reductions and loan extensions. Despite these recurring policy targets, owning or renting a home remains increasingly difficult for millions. The government continues to approach affordability as a financing problem, rather than addressing the underlying drivers of the housing crisis.

stories.title: Khan Market maintains top rank in Indian retail rents
stories.summary: New Delhi's Khan Market is India's most expensive retail street, with annual rents reaching 238 dollars per square foot. Cushman and Wakefield reports a 14 percent year-on-year increase in rents at the location, which currently holds the 24th spot in global retail rankings.

stories.title: TA Realty pitches three data centers in Prince William County - The Business Journals
Data center demand seen as inevitable
stories.summary: Paul Wyman of The Wyman Group told a Jasper Chamber of Commerce seminar that the growth of data centers is not a trend that will reverse. Mayor Ryan Craig facilitated the event to discuss the future of local real estate in relation to energy and data infrastructure.

stories.title: As AI Robots Take Over Factories, How Much Space Do They Need? - Bloomberg.com
Lehigh Valley industrial space construction hits multi-year high
stories.summary: Large industrial buildings for manufacturing and warehousing are seeing renewed construction in the Lehigh Valley. Lehigh Valley Economic Development Corp reports 4.5 million square feet of industrial properties were under construction in the third quarter of 2026, the highest level since early 2023.

stories.title: Industrial real estate competition returns as demand broadens
stories.summary: Link Logistics reports that the industrial real estate market is shifting as demand builds and competition for space returns. Tenants who previously enjoyed the luxury of time and plentiful options are now facing a narrowing window for negotiations as leasing criteria continue to evolve.

stories.title: Data center construction costs rise 13 percent
stories.summary: The cost to build data centers rose 13 percent year-over-year in 2026. CNBC reports that demand for artificial intelligence computing power has outpaced the supply of powered land and labor, creating increased risk and longer timelines for contractors tasked with building the necessary infrastructure.

stories.title: Plaquemines Parish to host new industrial marine terminal
stories.summary: American Gulf Marine Terminals will establish a new marine terminal in Louisiana, expected to create 531 direct and indirect jobs. Governor Jeff Landry stated the project strengthens the state's position in national infrastructure, with participating companies projecting an average annual salary of 70,000 dollars for new hires.

stories.title: Cummins India sees data centers drive power generation sales
stories.summary: Cummins India reports that data center power generation now accounts for 30 to 40 percent of its segment revenue. To manage rising commodity and input costs, the company is implementing progressive price hikes across its domestic portfolio to protect its operating margins.

stories.title: Noida elevated road remains closed after cave-in
stories.summary: A section of the Maharaja Agrasen Marg Elevated Road has been closed since October 21 following a road cave-in near the ISKCON Temple. Repair work has not made significant progress, forcing traffic onto lower roads and increasing congestion in surrounding sectors.

stories.title: Uttar Pradesh targets global defense manufacturing
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh is positioning itself as a national and global investment destination by centering its industrial strategy on defense manufacturing, aerospace, and logistics. The state aims to leverage world-class connectivity and skilled human resources to expand its role in global value chains and drive industrial competitiveness.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh outlines 2047 economic vision
stories.summary: The Andhra Pradesh government has launched a Vision 2047 framework to transform the state into an industrial hub. The plan divides the state into three economic regions centered around Amaravati, Visakhapatnam, and Tirupati, aiming to attract international investment and generate large-scale employment through regional infrastructure development.

stories.title: India bullet train construction reaches 508 km
stories.summary: India is currently constructing a 508 km high-speed rail corridor between Mumbai and Ahmedabad. The project includes an undersea tunnel and 371 km of completed viaducts. Officials state the first service is scheduled to begin in the final quarter of 2027. The project is no longer an announcement.

stories.title: Piyush Goyal hails 12 years of ‘Make in India’, says PM Modi’s vision of manufacturing for the world is taking shape - D
Bullet Train To Link Delhi, Lucknow And Guwahati: Check Proposed Route And Travel Times - News18
Mumbai-Ahmedabad rail project costs double
stories.summary: The cost of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail Corridor has risen from Rs 1.08 trillion to Rs 2.03 trillion. The project, implemented by the National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited, has already incurred expenditures of Rs 927.61 billion as of March 2026. Costs have a tendency to travel.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh reports 714 industrial projects
stories.summary: Andhra Pradesh claims investment proposals worth Rs 32.49 lakh crore since June 2024, with the potential to create 19.3 lakh jobs. The state recently secured 109 agreements worth Rs 9,02,434 crore at the CII Partnership Summit. The government is now focusing on regional industrial clusters to sustain growth.

stories.title: PM Gati Shakti master plan integrated with geospatial maps to prevent cost overruns: Union minister Piyush G.. - ET Auto
Milburn report addresses real estate accessibility
stories.summary: The newly published Milburn Review has brought industry attention to the accessibility of real estate careers for young people. The report focuses on improving opportunities for individuals from diverse and under-represented backgrounds, prompting the sector to evaluate how it presents itself to the next generation of workers.

stories.title: Supreme Court rules against housing board demand
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has dismissed a Rs 388 crore demand against Gaursons India Pvt. Ltd. The Court ruled that the Uttar Pradesh Housing Board could not treat land provided in exchange for previously acquired property as a fresh commercial allotment subject to bulk sale rates. The demand was quashed.

stories.title: Delhi safety survey requires 40 lakh man-hours
stories.summary: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi estimates that a preliminary safety survey of its 40 lakh buildings will require 40 lakh man-hours. The civic body is currently developing uniform assessment criteria to collate building data across multiple departments. The survey remains in the planning phase.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu sanctions 1,604 urban projects
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government has sanctioned 1,604 urban infrastructure projects worth Rs 386.9 crore for the 2026-27 period. The package includes road renewals and construction across municipalities and town panchayats. The state will provide the majority of the funding, with local bodies contributing the remainder.

stories.title: Centre considers mandatory structural audits
stories.summary: The central government is considering amendments to Delhi building bye-laws to require structural safety certifications every 15 to 20 years. This follows reports of 332 house collapse calls and 32 deaths between May and October 2026. Safety is being reconsidered through regulation.

stories.title: Tenants retain right to quiet possession
stories.summary: Legal experts state that tenants are entitled to privacy and quiet possession of their rented homes. While landlords may hold spare keys, the right to enter a property without informing the occupant is distinct from the physical ability to access the unit. Privacy remains a contractual expectation.

stories.title: Court upholds murder charges in building collapse
stories.summary: The Calcutta High Court has refused to quash murder and attempt to murder charges against a promoter following a March 2024 building collapse that killed 15 people. The petitioner challenged the framing of charges, but the court maintained the legal proceedings against him.

stories.title: Real estate commission hosts condominium webinar
stories.summary: The Real Estate Commission and the Community Associations Institute Hawaiʻi Chapter are hosting a free webinar on November 21. The event will cover condominium community topics, including civil rights complaints and legal compliance. The session is open to the public and will be recorded for later viewing.

stories.title: Transportation contractors face rising material costs
stories.summary: Transportation contractors are reporting pressure from material shortages and a 16.7 percent increase in asphalt prices during October 2026. Projects, including the Cam Lo to La Son expressway expansion, are managing these rising costs and supply delays. The industry is currently balancing price hikes with project timelines.

stories.title: Motilal Oswal launches commercial realty fund
stories.summary: Motilal Oswal Alternates has launched its first fund dedicated to Indian commercial real estate with a target corpus of Rs 3,000 crore. The fund plans to partner with developers on Grade A office projects in tier-I cities. The firm is seeking to capitalize on institutional leasing demand.

stories.title: Nifty Realty index nears record high
stories.summary: The Nifty Realty index rose 1.25 percent on Friday to 934.60. A CNBC-TV18 graphic suggests a 15.98 percent gain over the past month, with market commentary claiming the index is on track for its biggest monthly increase in six years. The index has not confirmed these figures.

stories.title: Indian REITs distribute Rs 3,234 crore in second quarter
stories.summary: Six publicly listed Indian REITs distributed over Rs 3,234 crore to more than 5.25 lakh unitholders during the second quarter of FY27. The sector reported a total gross asset value exceeding Rs 3.30 lakh crore, with a combined market capitalisation surpassing Rs 2.09 lakh crore as of November 17.

stories.title: Six listed REITs report quarterly distributions
stories.summary: The six publicly traded REITs distributed over Rs 3,234 crore to unitholders in the second quarter. Indian REITs Association chairman Shirish Godbole noted total distributions since inception now exceed Rs 38,000 crore. A year-on-year comparison remains difficult as the previous period included only five listed entities.

stories.title: CIRE Equity adds CREIT to iCapital Marketplace
stories.summary: CIRE Equity has listed its perpetual-life, nontraded private REIT on the iCapital Marketplace. The fund focuses on diversified commercial assets across the western and southwestern United States. As of September 30, the portfolio held approximately $1.6 billion in gross asset value across 60 investments.

stories.title: Prism Johnson reports second-quarter revenue
stories.summary: Prism Johnson reported consolidated revenue of INR 1,877.24 crore for the second quarter. The company reduced its net debt to INR 467 crore from INR 888 crore in March. Reported profit was bolstered by the sale of Raheja QBE, which the company advises separating from continuing operations.

stories.title: WHLR: Wheeler agrees to sell up to $13.6M in new notes to investors - Quantisnow
Wheeler REIT issues additional notes
stories.summary: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust has signed agreements to issue additional notes following a previous $8.295 million offering. The company filed a Form 8-K with the Securities and Exchange Commission on November 20 to confirm the latest financial activity.

stories.title: LA Fire and Police Pensions increases Townsend fund commitment
stories.summary: The Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions fund has approved a $30 million follow-on commitment to Townsend Group’s fourth global real estate secondaries fund. The pension fund previously committed $60 million to the vehicle in April 2025. The fund expects to close its $3 billion raise this year.

stories.title: Experion Developers discusses AI in real estate
stories.summary: Experion Developers CIO Amit Dixit discussed the role of artificial intelligence in the Indian real estate sector during a Mint Techcetra episode. The conversation focused on using technology to manage customer interactions, lead qualification and construction operations to create a 360-degree view of home buyers.

stories.title: Comparing property search platforms
stories.summary: A review of NoBroker, 99acres and Magicbricks suggests that while all three platforms offer search filters and listings, the actual utility depends on owner contactability and post-search services. The comparison highlights the gap between a digital noticeboard and a platform that handles agreements and verification.

stories.title: NoBroker reports growth in home services
stories.summary: NoBroker says its home services business now serves nearly 2 lakh customers monthly. The company also reported a 25-30 percent year-on-year increase in festive-season property transactions. CEO Amit Kumar Agarwal attributed the service growth to the company's existing operational scale in maintenance and repairs.

stories.title: AI To Drive India's Building Automation Market To $12.5 Billion: Report - NDTV
AI aims to connect real estate workflows
stories.summary: A Realtors Property Resource survey suggests the industry is looking for ways to integrate AI into daily tasks. The goal is to move beyond drafting documents toward connecting disparate systems, allowing professionals to access order requirements and status updates in a single view.

stories.title: ORGATEC India 2026 highlights commercial growth
stories.summary: ORGATEC India 2026 is currently underway in Mumbai, focusing on workplace design and smart building systems. The event follows reports of a 15 percent rise in commercial real estate investments. Industry participants are discussing a roadmap for growth amid shifting office infrastructure requirements.

stories.title: ORGATEC India 2026 exhibition opens in Mumbai
stories.summary: The second edition of ORGATEC India 2026 opened at the Jio World Convention Centre, featuring over 100 brands and 11,000 expected visitors. The exhibition covers workplace development, including office furniture and sustainable infrastructure, with programming scheduled through November 21.

stories.title: Office furniture market projected to reach $7.78 billion
stories.summary: Mordor Intelligence data projects India's office furniture market will grow from $4.81 billion in 2025 to $7.78 billion by 2031. Growth is attributed to record commercial real estate absorption and enterprise-wide workplace modernization. The sector is currently experiencing a high-growth phase.

stories.title: Privyr reaches 2.8 lakh users in India
stories.summary: Privyr, a mobile-first CRM platform, reports 2.8 lakh users across 2.5 lakh organisations in India. The platform has processed 189 million leads since 2018, with adoption spanning real estate, automotive and health sectors. WhatsApp currently accounts for 54 percent of contact activity on the service.

stories.title: India’s Office Furniture Market Projected to Reach $8 Billion by 2031 - Realty Plus Magazine
Tyre retail shifts toward customer service
stories.summary: Tyre retail is evolving from a functional transaction into a customer-focused, technology-enabled service industry. The sector is moving away from the traditional neighbourhood shop model, which relied on individual technician skill, toward a system featuring trained technicians and better equipment. The buying experience is now part of the value.

stories.title: Azerbaijan construction materials output grows
stories.summary: Azerbaijan's construction materials output grew 4.5 percent over the last ten months. The data comes from the latest regional industry reports.

stories.title: Greek road uses steel waste for durability
stories.summary: Researchers at Aristotle University of Thessaloniki found that a road built with steelmaking waste remained in very good condition after a decade of heavy truck traffic. The pilot project demonstrated that industrial byproducts can perform successfully in real-world conditions. The road has survived ten years of trucks.

stories.title: Qatar tests steel slag in asphalt roads
stories.summary: Engineers in Qatar found that asphalt made with steel slag resisted permanent deformation better than conventional pavement during a three-year trial. The material, a byproduct of steelmaking, performed as well as traditional gabbro rock. Steel waste is being asked to hold up the country's traffic.

stories.title: CSIR transfers bio-bitumen technology to industry
stories.summary: The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research has transferred technology that converts rice straw into bio-bitumen for road construction. The material is intended to partially replace petroleum-based bitumen. The institute handed over the technology to industry partners at its New Delhi headquarters yesterday.

stories.title: India's construction chemicals market to nearly... - Pluang
Dubai to launch building materials passport
stories.summary: Dubai Municipality will release a Building Materials Passport in early 2027 to track steel, aluminium and cement. The mandatory scheme will require manufacturers to register technical specifications in a central system. The municipality aims to eventually cover every building material used in the city's construction industry.

stories.title: Experts call for road decarbonisation in India
stories.summary: Experts at an Indian Roads Congress session in Hyderabad recommended addressing emissions across the entire infrastructure lifecycle. Former chief engineer A.P. Bahadur and Prof. Mahesh Tandon suggested that transport demand, road design and construction materials must be prioritised to reduce the environmental impact of India's expanding road network.

stories.title: Grand Rapids farm builds net-zero greenhouse
stories.summary: An urban farm in Grand Rapids is constructing an all-electric greenhouse with the goal of achieving net-zero operations. The project, supported by grants from Blue Cross Blue Shield and Amway, aims to improve community access to fresh produce. The farm is currently located just off Ball Road.

stories.title: Zero-waste housebuilding is shifting gears. Is the pace fast enough? - Financial Times
India targets 20 percent renewable capacity growth
stories.summary: India's renewable energy capacity could grow 20 percent by 2030, according to an IEA report. The country increased biofuel production sixfold between 2020 and 2025 and plans to introduce sustainable aviation fuel blending targets for international flights starting in 2027. Policy support includes domestic sourcing requirements for solar modules.

stories.title: Nestlé India starts clean corridor in Gurugram
stories.summary: Nestlé India has inaugurated a 16-km clean corridor between Ambience Mall and Rajiv Chowk in Gurugram. The initiative uses mechanised sweeping, water sprinkling and waste collection to maintain the highway stretch. The project aims to address dust and pollution concerns ahead of the winter months.

stories.title: Juniper Green commissions 109 MW solar capacity
stories.summary: Juniper Green Energy has commissioned 109 MW of solar capacity in Maharashtra and added 95 MWh of battery storage in Rajasthan. The company's operational portfolio now stands at 2.95 GW of renewable energy and 698 MWh of battery storage. The firm continues to expand its hybrid project footprint.

stories.title: Bend library earns LEED Platinum status
stories.summary: The Central Library in Bend has received LEED Platinum certification for its sustainability efforts. It is one of two public buildings in Deschutes County to hold the status. The library director noted that the facility prioritises both functional design and the health of its customers.

stories.title: Salisbury University named among greenest campuses
stories.summary: Salisbury University has been included in The Princeton Review's Guide to Green Colleges for the 17th consecutive year. The guide, produced with the U.S. Green Building Council, highlights the university's environmental and sustainability programs. The school remains in the top 35 most sustainable institutions in the nation.

stories.title: Sony said to abandon talks to anchor $2.7B Hudson Yards tower - Crain's New York
New York luxury rentals see influx of cash from AI boom
stories.summary: The AI boom has reached New York City, where an already tight luxury market is feeling the impact of newly minted millionaires. With over 2,000 AI companies now operating in the city, agents say the influence of deep-pocketed professionals is just beginning to be felt. Space remains limited.

stories.title: LaSalle Street tower housing city offices poised to sell for steep discount - Crain's Chicago Business
Ex-Revlon head Perelman unloads second townhouse on East 63rd Street - Crain's New York
Bronx real estate broker with criminal record faces fourth round of charges - Crain's New York
Asia Pacific commercial real estate investment falls 13 percent in Q3
stories.summary: Asia Pacific commercial real estate recorded $54.3 billion in investment during the third quarter of 2026, a 13 percent year-over-year decline. While volume remains above historical averages, higher borrowing costs and near-historic-low yield spreads are weighing on dealmaking. The recovery has encountered a ceiling.

stories.title: Hongkong Land renames Singapore retail property after acquisition
stories.summary: Hongkong Land has renamed the former Wheelock Place complex in Singapore to Landmark Orchard following an $850 million acquisition. The property was purchased through the company's Singapore Central Private Real Estate Fund, marking the fund's first deal since launching in February 2026. A name change is included.

stories.title: Downtown Vancouver office vacancies reach two-decade highs
stories.summary: Downtown Vancouver office vacancy rates have hit highs not seen in over twenty years. With no new office buildings in the pipeline, some owners are now exploring hotel conversions for older, obsolete properties. The market is adjusting to a surplus of empty space.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO triggers tech wealth migration to South Florida
stories.summary: Following Anthropic's $1.5 trillion IPO, real estate insiders expect a wave of newly liquid engineers and backers to relocate to South Florida in 2027. Experts describe the region as nearing an irreversible point of no return as tech wealth seeks to escape high-tax states. Florida is waiting.
